question_text: The Anti-Red Tape Act (ARTA) of 2007, or Republic Act No. 9485, aims to streamline government processes and improve public service delivery. It mandates all government offices to set up a Public Assistance and Complaints Desk, implement a Citizen's Charter, and observe the 'fixer-free' policy. The law also requires agencies to process transactions within a reasonable period and penalizes officials who violate its provisions. What is the author's primary purpose in writing this passage?

options.text: To criticize government offices for their inefficiency
To inform readers about the key provisions of ARTA
To persuade readers to file complaints against erring officials
To entertain readers with stories about red tape
